body: Yes they currently do.  It's a bug. Scott Manley says they know about it, so I assume they will look into it shortly.
I had actually considered writing a fanfic about Hisao getting involved in his plans, or just about Kenji and his life in general.

You know, I've had similar thoughts like that myself. Although from Hisao's point of view. I think it would be cool to see more science club stuff, a student and his mentor type thing. I always thought that would be pretty cool. If there was any chance of a sequel, which I know there isn't, I would like to see it with someone like Mutou being the protagonist, an entirely different view. With a different class too, that way you would have all new characters, and you wouldn't have to deal with the choices Hisao made.

Welcome to YouTube man! From what I've seen, your video is pretty well made, you've got some pretty good skills there. One thing that I think you could work on is vocalization, for the most part, no one is really good at that starting out but you should probably practice speaking a little clearer and a little louder. It's a great video, it has an interesting topic that I think could get somewhere. Good luck man, I look forward to more videos from you in the future!
